## Specific task description

Task instruction: Hold the decorative golden tea box in one arm and the scanner for barcode scanning in the other to scan the decorative golden tea box.

Task description: Targets are the gold-decorated tea box at the front right and black scanner lying horizontally at the front left. Each arm holds one; aim the scanner's scanning end at the tea box at close range to scan.

Success criteria: Separate arms must hold the tea box and scanner, with both grippers closed. The tea box must be very close directly in front of the scanning end, whose forward axis points at the box with minimal lateral and vertical offset.

## Execution tips

- Grip a straight middle section of the scanner's black handle with pads on both sides, avoiding the broad scanning head and narrowed end to reduce slipping and preserve scanning clearance.
- Consider gripping the tea box on flat areas of two opposite sides, keeping the pads within the faces and away from the corners, and leaving space on the side facing the scanner head to reduce off-center gripping and obstruction.
- Adjust the opening to the handle or box grasp width. Before closing, confirm the fingers are on opposite sides of the grasp area. If the view is unclear, adjust observation or approach position slightly to avoid merely pushing the object with a finger.
- Use free space above the table to adjust orientation, watching clearance for the scanner head, box corners, and both sets of fingers. During close alignment, keep one item steady and make small angular and distance corrections with the other to reduce collisions or deviations from the scanning direction.
